followed by two 4-byte buffer descriptors (lo address, hi page,
end lo, end hi). End bytes `&FF` are placeholders filled in later
by the caller.

memory_map.name: zp_0063
memory_map.description: (false ref from inline string data)

memory_map.name: zp_0078

memory_map.name: net_rx_ptr

memory_map.name: nfs_workspace_hi
memory_map.description: General NFS workspace pointer (high)

memory_map.name: nmi_tx_block

memory_map.description: Block to be transmitted (high)

memory_map.description: Open port buffer address (low)

memory_map.name: nmi_romsel
memory_map.description:
ROM-bank number patched into the NMI shim.
The NMI handler runs in the active sideways slot, so the shim begins by paging in the NFS ROM bank (this byte) before dispatching to the body.

memory_map.name: nmi_jmp_lo
memory_map.description:
NMI dispatch JMP-target low byte.
Patched by [`set_nmi_vector`](label:set_nmi_vector) and [`install_nmi_handler`](label:install_nmi_handler). The NMI shim does `JMP (nmi_jmp_lo)` to reach the current handler.

memory_map.name: nmi_jmp_hi
memory_map.description:
NMI dispatch JMP-target high byte.
Paired with [`nmi_jmp_lo`](label:nmi_jmp_lo). Only [`set_nmi_vector`](label:set_nmi_vector) writes this; [`install_nmi_handler`](label:install_nmi_handler) leaves it alone (same-page optimisation).

memory_map.name: set_nmi_vector
memory_map.description:
NMI vector update (both bytes).
`STY` [nmi_jmp_hi](label:nmi_jmp_hi) then `STA` [nmi_jmp_lo](label:nmi_jmp_lo), writing the full 16-bit NMI handler address into the JMP-target slot. Falls through to [`nmi_rti`](label:nmi_rti).

memory_map.name: install_nmi_handler
memory_map.description:
NMI vector update (low byte only).
`STA` [nmi_jmp_lo](label:nmi_jmp_lo) only, leaving the existing high byte at [`nmi_jmp_hi`](label:nmi_jmp_hi) in place. Same-page optimisation used when the next handler is in the same page as the current one. Falls through to [`nmi_rti`](label:nmi_rti).

memory_map.name: nmi_rti
memory_map.description:
NMI exit shim.
Restores the previous ROM bank, pulls Y and A off the stack, reads `BIT enable_net_nmis` (INTON, re-enables /NMI), and `RTI`s. Reached either as a fall-through from [`set_nmi_vector`](label:set_nmi_vector) / [`install_nmi_handler`](label:install_nmi_handler), or as a direct branch from any NMI handler that has finished early.

Base of the 12-byte RX scout data buffer.

memory_map.name: scout_src_net

Scout control byte ([`scout_buf`](label:scout_buf)+2).

memory_map.description:
Source station of the received scout frame.

memory_map.name: net_frame_flags
memory_map.description:
TX / transfer flags for the current Econet frame, initialised during
scout receive and carried through the reply and data-TX phases:

| Bit | Meaning |
|-----|---------|
| 0 | handshake-data pending |
| 1 | data transfer routes into the Tube buffer |
| 6 | broadcast frame (scout addressed to station &FF) |

memory_map.name: rx_ctrl
memory_map.description: Control byte of the received scout frame.

memory_map.name: rx_port
memory_map.description:
Port byte of the received scout frame.
Matched against the open RXCB list to find a listener (or the immediate-op port range &80..&88).

memory_map.name: rx_remote_addr
memory_map.description: Remote address byte for received TX setup.

memory_map.name: rx_extra_byte
memory_map.description: Extra trailing RX data byte.

memory_map.name: saved_nmi_lo
memory_map.description:
Saved next NMI handler address (low byte).
Written by [`ack_tx_write_dest`](label:ack_tx_write_dest) from the (A=lo, Y=hi) pair on entry, then consumed when the next NMI fires.

memory_map.name: saved_nmi_hi
memory_map.description:
Saved next NMI handler address (high byte).
Paired with [`saved_nmi_lo`](label:saved_nmi_lo).

memory_map.name: tx_flags
memory_map.description:
TX path control flags.
Bit 7: TX path is active (used by [`nmi_error_dispatch`](label:nmi_error_dispatch) to choose between RX-error reset and TX-fail dispatch).
Bit 0: handshake-data pending.
Bit 1: data-RX into Tube buffer (selected by [`install_data_rx_handler`](label:install_data_rx_handler)).

memory_map.name: nmi_next_lo
memory_map.description:
Next NMI handler address (low byte).
Saved by the scout / data-RX handler; consumed by [`ack_tx`](label:ack_tx) when installing the post-ACK NMI handler.

memory_map.name: nmi_next_hi
memory_map.description:
Next NMI handler address (high byte).
Paired with [`nmi_next_lo`](label:nmi_next_lo).

memory_map.name: tx_index
memory_map.description: Index into the TX buffer (current byte position).

memory_map.name: tx_length
memory_map.description: Total length of the TX data payload.

memory_map.name: tx_complete_flag
memory_map.description:
TX completion semaphore.
Bit 7 set by the NMI TX-completion handler; polled by `wait_net_tx_ack` to detect frame completion.

memory_map.name: econet_flags
memory_map.description:
Econet control flags.
Bit 7: port-list active. Bit 2: halt requested.

memory_map.name: econet_init_flag
memory_map.description:
Econet-initialised flag.
Bit 7 set when the NMI shim has been installed; checked at every NMI to reject pre-init interrupts.

memory_map.name: tube_present
memory_map.description:
Tube co-processor presence flag.
Probed at init via OSBYTE `&EA`; read by every TX/RX path that needs to forward data through the Tube.

memory_map.name: ws_0d64
memory_map.description: ANFS workspace byte (role TBD).

memory_map.name: tx_op_type
memory_map.description:
Deferred-work / TX-operation type flag.
Set by NMI handlers to mark pending work; polled by [`svc5_irq_check`](label:svc5_irq_check) as the dispatch trigger.

memory_map.name: exec_addr_lo
memory_map.description:
Remote execution address (low byte).
Stored by remote-JSR / immediate-op paths; consumed when the queued operation runs.

memory_map.name: exec_addr_hi
memory_map.description:
Remote execution address (high byte).
Paired with [`exec_addr_lo`](label:exec_addr_lo).

memory_map.name: prot_status
memory_map.description: Econet per-station protection mask (LSTAT): one bit per immediate operation; a set bit bars that operation. Tested by immediate_op; bits 2-4 (JSR/UserProc/OSProc) are raised during a deferred remote call for re-entrancy protection.

memory_map.name: prot_status_save
memory_map.description: Saved copy of the prot_status protection mask (OLDJSR in Acorn's DNFS source), preserved while bits 2-4 are raised during a deferred remote call so the original mask can be restored afterwards.

memory_map.name: ws_0d6a
memory_map.description: ANFS workspace byte (role TBD).

memory_map.name: spool_buf_idx
memory_map.description: Spool / printer buffer write index.

memory_map.name: fs_flags
memory_map.description:
Filing-system status flags.
Bit 7: NFS is currently the selected FS; cleared when another FS takes over.

memory_map.name: tx_retry_count
memory_map.description:
Transmit retry count (default `&FF` = 255).
Settable via OSWORD `&13` PB[1].

memory_map.name: rx_wait_timeout
memory_map.description:
Receive wait timeout (default `&28` = 40).
Settable via OSWORD `&13` PB[2].

memory_map.name: peek_retry_count
memory_map.description:
Machine peek retry count (default `&0A` = 10).
Settable via OSWORD `&13` PB[3].

memory_map.name: spool_control_flag
memory_map.description: Multi-purpose: spool-buffer control flag (printer spooling); also doubles as the bridge-routing-table status byte read by [`init_bridge_poll`](label:init_bridge_poll) (`&FF` = uninitialised, anything else = bridge already polled).

memory_map.name: bridge_status
memory_map.description:
Bridge station number (`&FF` = no bridge).
Set by the bridge-discovery scout reply; checked before any cross-network operation.

memory_map.name: rom_ws_pages
memory_map.description: MOS per-ROM workspace page table (16 bytes, one per sideways-ROM slot). Each entry is the high byte of the page allocated to that ROM's absolute workspace.

memory_map.name: fs_cmd_csd
memory_map.description: TXCB port byte / CSD (current selected directory) handle.

memory_map.name: fs_cmd_data
memory_map.description: TX buffer data start / FS reply data.

memory_map.name: filename_buf
memory_map.description: Filename display buffer (12 bytes). Used by directory listing and *Info to format filenames.

memory_map.name: hazel_fs_station
memory_map.description:
Filing-system state block (`&C000`–`&C00A`).

Eleven bytes of currently-selected-FS context kept in HAZEL: station / network of the FS, saved prefix station, multi-purpose CSD/library/boot-type slots, FS flags, messages flag, pending-state, error code, last-error, and `*OPT` addend. The first two bytes (`hazel_fs_station`, `hazel_fs_network`) are the FS address used for every TX scout.

memory_map.name: hazel_fs_network
memory_map.description: FS network number (sub-byte of the &C000 FS context block).

memory_map.name: hazel_fs_context_copy
memory_map.description: Multi-purpose sub-byte of the &C000 block: CSD handle / matched-entry index / Y-indexed base into FS context block.

memory_map.name: hazel_fs_prefix_stn
memory_map.description: Multi-purpose sub-byte of the &C000 block: saved-prefix station / library handle / boot type.

memory_map.name: hazel_fs_error_code
memory_map.description: FS error code (sub-byte of the &C000 block).

memory_map.name: hazel_fs_last_error
memory_map.description: Last FS error byte (sub-byte of the &C000 block).

memory_map.name: hazel_retry_counter
memory_map.description: Retry counter for the current Econet TX/RX cycle.

memory_map.name: hazel_parse_buf
memory_map.description: Three-byte parse-buffer used for command-line matching (e.g. `*OPT`, `*FS`).

memory_map.name: hazel_rtc_buffer
memory_map.description: OSWORD `&0E` real-time-clock result buffer.

memory_map.name: hazel_fs_reply_byte
memory_map.description: Latched first byte of the most recent FS reply.

memory_map.name: hazel_txcb_port
memory_map.description: TXCB byte 0: port number for the next TX scout.

memory_map.name: hazel_txcb_func_code
memory_map.description: TXCB byte 1: function code (FS command number).

memory_map.name: hazel_txcb_station
memory_map.description: TXCB byte 2: destination station.

memory_map.name: hazel_txcb_network
memory_map.description:
TXCB byte 3: multi-purpose.
TXCB destination network (TX setup) / reply function code (RX context) / `fs_cmd_csd` buffer base (other paths).

memory_map.name: hazel_txcb_lib
memory_map.description: TXCB byte 4: library handle terminator / transfer-length param 1.

memory_map.name: hazel_txcb_data
memory_map.description: TXCB byte 5: first reply-data byte / data start.

memory_map.name: hazel_txcb_flag
memory_map.description: TXCB byte 6: direction flag.

memory_map.name: hazel_txcb_count
memory_map.description: TXCB byte 7: data count / lock flag.

memory_map.name: hazel_txcb_result
memory_map.description: TXCB byte 8: result / transfer-size lo.

memory_map.name: hazel_fcb_addr_lo
memory_map.description:
FCB parallel array (16 entries): file position byte 0 (low).
Indexed by channel `0..15`; cleared by [`alloc_fcb_slot`](label:alloc_fcb_slot) on FCB allocation.

memory_map.name: hazel_fcb_addr_mid
memory_map.description: FCB parallel array (16 entries): file position byte 1 (mid).

memory_map.name: hazel_fcb_addr_hi
memory_map.description: FCB parallel array (16 entries): file position byte 2 (high).

memory_map.name: hazel_fcb_slot_attr
memory_map.description:
FCB parallel array (16 entries): slot occupancy + channel attribute.
Tested for zero by [`alloc_fcb_slot`](label:alloc_fcb_slot) as the slot-free check; set non-zero on allocation.

memory_map.name: hazel_fcb_state_byte
memory_map.description:
FCB parallel array (16 entries): multi-purpose state byte.
Holds station number for non-OSFIND channels, or open-mode flags for channels created by OSFIND.

memory_map.name: hazel_fcb_network
memory_map.description: FCB parallel array (16 entries): network number per channel.

memory_map.name: hazel_fcb_status
memory_map.description:
FCB parallel array (16 entries): per-channel status flags.
Heavily used: bit 6 = connection active (`set_conn_active` / `clear_conn_active` toggle).

memory_map.name: hazel_fs_lib_flags
memory_map.description: FS library / option flags. Bit 2 = auto-boot, bit 7 = library-directory pending. Cleared / tested by *Cat / *Lcat / *Ex / *Lex paths.

memory_map.name: hazel_cur_fcb_index
memory_map.description: Current FCB index used by the FCB-scan loop in [`process_all_fcbs`](label:process_all_fcbs). Followed by the channel attribute / reference, byte-counter, buffer pointer and a small block of transfer-state scratch bytes used during file I/O.

memory_map.name: hazel_sentinel_cd
memory_map.description: Sentinel/scratch byte at HAZEL+&CD, used by the FCB-scan loop in [`process_all_fcbs`](label:process_all_fcbs).

memory_map.name: hazel_sentinel_ce
memory_map.description: Sentinel/scratch byte at HAZEL+&CE, used by the FCB-scan loop in [`process_all_fcbs`](label:process_all_fcbs).

memory_map.name: hazel_ctx_buffer
memory_map.description: HAZEL context buffer (saved register / state block used during FCB processing).

memory_map.name: fdc_1770_command_or_status
memory_map.description:
Master 128 1770 floppy-disk-controller command (write) / status
(read) register, part of the `&FE24`-`&FE2F` disk interface. ANFS does not
do disk I/O; the only access is a discarded read in `set_rom_ws_page`
(its result is overwritten before use).

memory_map.name: fdc_1770_data
memory_map.description:
Master 128 1770 floppy-disk-controller data register, part of the
`&FE24`-`&FE2F` disk interface. ANFS does not do disk I/O; the only
access is a discarded read in `set_rom_ws_page` (its result is
overwritten before use).

memory_map.name: acccon
memory_map.description:
Master 128 ACCCON access-control register.

Bit-by-bit (write-only):

| Bit | Name | Effect when set |
|---|---|---|
| 7 | IRR | Interrupt Request: setting it asserts the CPU IRQ line (a software-triggered IRQ) |
| 6 | TST | Test mode |
| 5 | IFJ | I/O is JIM |
| 4 | ITU | Internal Tube |
| 3 | Y   | HAZEL paged in (`&C000-&DFFF` is hidden RAM) |
| 2 | X   | LYNNE paged in (`&3000-&7FFF` is shadow RAM) |
| 1 | E   | shadow RAM owns screen |
| 0 | D   | shadow RAM for the OS display |

ANFS uses bit 7 (IRR) as a deferred-work latch via `TRB`/`TSB`.

memory_map.name: disable_net_nmis
memory_map.description:
Master 128 INTOFF mirror (NMI-disable side effect).
Reading any byte here disables /NMI re-entry; the byte value itself is irrelevant.

memory_map.name: enable_net_nmis
memory_map.description:
Master 128 INTON mirror (NMI-enable side effect).
Reading any byte here re-enables /NMI; the byte value itself is irrelevant.

memory_map.name: econet_control1_or_status1
memory_map.description:
ADLC control register 1 / status register 1.
Write: `CR1` (or `CR3` if `AC=1`). Read: `SR1`.

`SR1` bits: `RDA` (b0), `S2RQ` (b1), `LOOP` (b2), `FD` (b3), `CTS` (b4), `TUF` (b5), `TDRA` (b6), `IRQ` (b7).

memory_map.name: econet_control23_or_status2
memory_map.description:
ADLC control register 2 / status register 2.
Write: `CR2` (or `CR4` if `AC=1`). Read: `SR2`.

`SR2` bits: `AP` (b0), `FV` (b1), `RX_IDLE` (b2), `RX_ABRT` (b3), `ERR` (b4), `DCD` (b5), `OVRN` (b6), `RDA` (b7).

memory_map.name: econet_data_continue_frame
memory_map.description:
ADLC TX FIFO continue / RX FIFO read.
Write: byte to TX FIFO with `LAST_DATA = 0` (continue frame).
Read: next byte from RX FIFO.

memory_map.name: econet_data_terminate_frame
memory_map.description:
ADLC TX FIFO terminate / RX FIFO read.
Write: final byte of frame (`LAST_DATA = 1`; ADLC appends CRC + closing flag).
Read: next byte from RX FIFO.

memory_map.name: ev_filev
memory_map.description: FILEV extended-vector dispatcher (file operations: OSFILE, OSFIND).

memory_map.name: ev_argsv
memory_map.description: ARGSV extended-vector dispatcher (file argument operations: OSARGS).

memory_map.name: ev_bgetv
memory_map.description: BGETV extended-vector dispatcher (single-byte read: OSBGET).

memory_map.name: ev_bputv
memory_map.description: BPUTV extended-vector dispatcher (single-byte write: OSBPUT).

memory_map.name: ev_gbpbv
memory_map.description: GBPBV extended-vector dispatcher (block transfer: OSGBPB).

memory_map.name: ev_findv
memory_map.description: FINDV extended-vector dispatcher (open / close: OSFIND).

memory_map.name: ev_fscv
memory_map.description: FSCV extended-vector dispatcher (filing-system control: OSFSC, *commands).

memory_map.name: nmi_buf_idx_base
memory_map.description:
NMI buffer indexing-base.
Used by the NMI RX setup as `STA nmi_buf_idx_base,Y` with Y values that wrap into low memory; the bytes at `&FFB0` themselves aren't read or written.

memory_map.name: fcb_workspace_idx_base
memory_map.description:
FCB-workspace indexing-base (wraps into ZP).
Used by `loop_save_fcb_workspace` as the base of `LDA &FFBD,X` with X=`&F7`..`&FF`; the effective address wraps to `&00B4`..`&00BC` (= `fs_work_4`+0..+8). The byte at `&FFBD` itself is never read.
